core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abram is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Exalted father”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Abram corresponds to the Arabic form إبراهيم (أ ب ر ه). Its core sense is exalted father. Abram is the Hebrew biblical form (אַבְרָם, 'exalted father'); the Arabic Qur'anic form is إبراهيم (Ibrāhīm). The two are related but not identical, and the source record conflated them.
